svg.title: Vedas Dixit, software engineer
svg.desc: A Mac window in the style of blog.vedasdixit.com. A photo of Vedas sketching on an iPad on a railway platform at night, with flowers growing out of the iPad. Hi, I’m Vedas. I’m a software engineer who likes making things for the people who use them. I love bringing ideas to life, working closely with founders and small teams. Lately that has been fintech and healthcare products with teams in the UK and the US, often as the only frontend engineer, writing the Go and SQL my features need. Usually the part people touch: React, Next.js, TypeScript. Sometimes the part they don’t: Go, SQL, Postgres. Always the small stuff: accessibility, speed, search. I make the internet feel a little more handmade.
